newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS -Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: RTRS -Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Oct 23.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Food group's shares fell sharply on Tuesday after the company's finace director, Les Cullen announced his resignation. * MIM Holdings Ltd A$1.69 (-.03)

MIM is reviewing long-term profitability plans at its McArthur River zinc-lead-silver mine in the Northern Territory following the prediction of a loss unless operational improvements occurred, the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Wednesday.

Westpac shares surged on Tuesday amid speculation National Australia Bank was planning a takeover once the Wallis inquiry concludes its report into the financial services system next March. Newspapers reported that stockbroker, BT Securities ruled out National Australia as Monday's purchaser of a A$130 million parcel of Westpac converting preference shares.

Energy company's managing director Len Bleasel told reporters after AGL's annual meeting on Tuesday, the company was interested in buying the A$300 million-plus of Australian gas assets owned by US energy group Tenneco.
